title.zh-Hans: 深圳 2026 备歌版（固定主流程＋可选点歌）

notes.zh-Hans: 深圳当前备歌版：正式主流程固定，包含《自由的你》《泡沫》《天空没有极限》；《画》《失真》《让你知道》是首场点歌示例，可按需打印，不代表每场都会点到。顺序和视频时长沿用首场记录。“敲鼓”曲名待核实，暂记 Kingdom Come。
notes.en: Prepare for the current Shenzhen programme: the fixed main set includes 自由的你, 泡沫, and 天空没有极限. The opening-night requests 画, 失真, and 让你知道 are optional to print and may differ on other nights. Order and video timings follow the opening-night record. The drum segment title remains provisional as Kingdom Come.

title.zh-Hans: I AM GLORIA 2.0 深圳终章首场（2026-09-11）
title.en: I AM GLORIA 2.0 Shenzhen Finale Opening Night (2026-09-11)

notes.zh-Hans: 这份首场实演记录保留 9 月 11 日的视频章节顺序、时长和当晚点歌，点歌不代表每场必唱。准备后续场次请使用“深圳 2026 备歌版”，其中正式主流程固定、现场点歌可选。日期、场馆与《自由的你》首演另有官方来源确认。“敲鼓”暂映射为 Kingdom Come；现场图中的 G.E.M. / Walk On Water 仅保留为待核验 cue，不额外加入视频章节未单列的歌曲。
notes.en: This dated record preserves the 11 September chapter order, timings, and songs requested that night; those requests are not required songs for every performance. Use Shenzhen 2026 Preparation for the current fixed formal program with optional requests. Official sources separately confirm the date, venue, and premiere of 自由的你. The drum segment remains provisionally mapped to Kingdom Come; G.E.M. / Walk On Water remains an unresolved cue without adding a song absent from the chapters.

sources.title: I AM GLORIA 2.0 Shenzhen opening-night video chapters and timings
sources.notes: User-pasted 42-segment sequence with 41 chapter durations. It is treated as observed performance evidence, not an official cue sheet. The final song has no supplied duration, and medley durations apply to the whole named segment.

sources.title: Complete Shenzhen opening-night video chapter list
sources.notes: The supplementary pasted video page includes the final 天空没有极限 chapter at 05:01. With this addition all 42 chapters have durations, totalling 2:33:22. Chapter lengths are not canonical song durations. Only performance metadata is retained; account details and unrelated comments are omitted.

sources.title: Current Shenzhen fixed formal program and optional live requests
sources.notes: The user explicitly confirms that the current Shenzhen formal choices are consistent and that 自由的你, 泡沫, and 天空没有极限 are fixed, while live requests are optional. This supports the preparation classification, not an official or irrevocable promise for all twelve dates. The drum segment title remains unresolved.

sources.title: On-site infrared-laser camera safety notice
sources.notes: The stadium screen lists songs using infrared-laser effects, including Kingdom Come and the combined cue G.E.M./Walk on water. It corroborates selected repertoire but is not a complete running order. The original image remains private and is not committed.

sources.title: Audience discussion about Shenzhen rotations and encore changes
sources.notes: Community comments speculate that the twelve Shenzhen shows share a fixed list and discuss encore changes. These claims are recorded for context only and are not used as an official guarantee of future-night sameness. The original screenshots remain private and are not committed.

sources.title: I AM GLORIA World Tour — Shenzhen dates
sources.notes: Official tour page confirming Shenzhen Universiade Sports Centre Stadium and all twelve Shenzhen dates from 11 September through 5 October 2026. It does not publish a running order.

sources.title: I AM GLORIA Shenzhen finale opening night
sources.notes: Official opening-night recap confirming that 11 September 2026 was the first of twelve Shenzhen shows and that the unreleased album lead single 自由的你 premiered that night. It does not publish the complete running order.

sources.title: Longgang Culture and Tourism Bureau reply on the Shenzhen concert
sources.notes: Government reply confirming twelve performances at Shenzhen Universiade Sports Centre Stadium between 11 September and 5 October 2026. It does not publish a running order.
